label: Bible Study
prompt: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim _____ throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verse: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
note: The Year of Jubilee — the line 'proclaim liberty throughout all the land' is engraved on America's Liberty Bell.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and _____, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verse: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
note: Around the throne the worship never stops, day or night: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our _____ are gone out.
verse: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
note: The five foolish virgins brought lamps but no extra oil, and the wise ones wouldn't risk sharing theirs.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, _____ thou bless me.
verse: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
note: Jacob wrestled all night and, hip out of joint, still wouldn't let go without a blessing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without _____, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verse: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
note: The promised land's brochure: bread without 'scarceness,' stones of iron, hills of brass. Then Moses warns: don't forget the Giver.
